name: default-off private paged attention admission and receipt contract
source_repository: original mlx2 implementation based on local codex/varlen-paged-attention revision adfe44d6970e39eddd044d5481d5b9503826712b
license: original mlx2 project code; no third-party implementation copied
modifications: Added candidate-only preflight pricing for one fixed two-plane arena and per-use page metadata, split scratch, COW copy staging and payload staging. Added explicit page-capacity and requested-feature refusals and a terminal-success-only receipt for actual paged rows and touched logical pages. Ordinary admission and routing APIs remain unchanged.
validation: CPU-only tests cover cold versus warm arena pricing, table/scratch/COW/staging terms, default-off and feature/page/headroom refusals, success/failure/abort and duplicate receipt behavior, and sliding-window touched-page counts; existing private-cache and plan tests rerun.
limitations: This is an estimate and host receipt contract. Arena residency and available headroom are caller-supplied; native allocation overhead is not measured. Fake-backend CPU completion is not a GPU proof. No serving route calls this API, no model adapter is selected, and no paged model-serving use or qualification is claimed.
